prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: Building on c016 (cap 5.6, TNS-heavy, score +0.412), modestly tighten the cap by x0.7 to 3.92 so weighting spreads over even more moderately-critical nets (TNS) while keeping the responsive decay=0.5 unchanged; this stays well inside the validated regime (c012 at decay 0.25 failed, but the cap is a separate, monotone-safe knob and c015/c016 bracket 5.6-11.2 as valid).
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.505 robust(mean-std)=+0.060 min_case=+0.087 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.087 dWNS=+4.4% dTNS=+11.6% overflow~131
  bp-ng45: score=+0.096 dWNS=+12.4% dTNS=+8.4% overflow~121
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.322 dWNS=+7.4% dTNS=+48.8% overflow~132
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: Hypothesis held: tightening cap to 3.92 improved all three cases (total +0.505, robust +0.060, all valid). Gains concentrate in bp_fe-ng45 (dTNS +48.8%, dWNS +7.4%), with smaller but consistent WNS/TNS improvements on ariane133 and bp. Mechanism: a lower cap spreads weighting over more moderately-critical nets, capturing additional TNS without disturbing the responsive decay=0.5 regime—consistent with the monotone-safe cap knob. Next step: probe cap 3.0–3.5 to locate the optimum, and verify overflow (~121–132) stays acceptable across seeds before adopting.
